name: Jonathan
summary: A son of King Saul and a bold warrior, who made a covenant of friendship with David and protected him from his father. He died beside Saul in battle on Mount Gilboa.

key_moments.title: Climbing to the Philistine Camp
key_moments.description: Jonathan and his armourbearer climbed up to a Philistine post alone, saying the LORD could save with many or with few. They struck down about twenty men, and the whole Philistine army trembled.

key_moments.title: Eats Honey Against Saul's Oath
key_moments.description: Not knowing his father had forbidden the army to eat that day, Jonathan tasted some honey. Saul would have put him to death, but the people rescued Jonathan.

key_moments.title: Makes a Covenant with David
key_moments.description: Jonathan loved David as much as himself and made a covenant with him. He gave David his robe, his sword, his bow and his belt.

key_moments.title: Warns David with Arrows
key_moments.description: Jonathan shot arrows past a boy as a sign to warn David that Saul meant to kill him. The two friends kissed and wept, and Jonathan sent David away in peace.

key_moments.title: Fallen at Gilboa
key_moments.description: The Philistines killed Jonathan with his father on Mount Gilboa. David mourned him in a song and said Jonathan had been very dear to him.
